priceScope: Conditional annual whole-recipient cost divided by a limited modeled local channel; not a verified marginal gift offer or complete portfolio EV

what: Brighter Bites distributes fresh produce to families through schools and community partners.
Nutrition education and cooking demonstrations help children and caregivers use that produce.
Its Houston program is part of a broader multiregional nonprofit.
strengths: Recurring distribution combines food access with practical preparation skills.
Houston schools and food-bank partners provide an established delivery network.
Published research examines dietary behaviors and family shopping mechanisms.
reservations: Mixed students,teachersandfamilies counts are not uniqueannual households.
Dietary behaviors and focus groups do not measure recipient clinicalQALYs or causalnetcashgain.
Nationalcost, Houstonallocation, fundingcuts and donatedresources require careful boundaries.

model.formula: Union=N*unique*b; clinical=union*completion*q*discounted finite years minus full union harms. Financial=.5*people*discounted one-year log(1+joint net gain/baseline), local share once. Headline=10*C/(clinical+financial).
model.attribution: Annual incremental recipient response is distinct from cohort deduplication and geographic share; no claim of whole annual portfolio or marginal donation causal effect.
model.uncertainty: Source-grounded original cost/services; all causal mapping, utility and net resource priors unsupported. Complete portfolio and marginal donor EV unknown.
